status: source-only galaxy-variety axes frozen before opening any kinematic value, choosing an evidence split, or deriving a gravity action
purpose: Turn the complete V19BV WALLABY source universe into a target-blind coverage frame for broad galaxy testing, while propagating release-row ambiguity and making no final sample or holdout choice.

catalog_field_units.schema_query: SELECT column_name,unit,description FROM TAP_SCHEMA.columns WHERE table_name='AS102.wallaby_pilot_dr1_sourcefind_cat_v01' AND column_name IN ('ell3s_maj','ell3s_min','dist_h','log_m_hi')

availability_lane.metadata_rule: canonical source row has published kflag=2
availability_lane.boundary: This means a public kinematic model exists. It does not inspect or score its velocity, inclination, position angle, residual, surface-density model, or halo result.

variety_axes.hi_compactness_proxy: log_m_hi - log10(ell3s_maj * ell3s_min * dist_h^2); a relative source-only proxy, not a calibrated physical surface density
variety_axes.source_extent_pixels: log10(max(ell3s_maj, ell3s_min)); the archive declares both ellipse axes in catalog pixels

binning.method: deterministic type-7 linear quartiles at 0.25, 0.50 and 0.75
binning.outcome_use: coverage diagnosis only; no target, formula score, fold, development/validation/holdout label, or final sample selection

claim_boundary: V19BW diagnoses whether the public WALLABY kinematic-availability lane spans varied source-side H I regimes; it does not claim that any object meets the final baryonic reconstruction or target-quality gates.
Quartiles are relative coverage labels, not galaxy classes and not inputs to the gravity equation.
The H I compactness quantity is deliberately a unit-insensitive relative proxy and is not called a physical surface density.
All five prespecified V19BV release-row choices are propagated into availability and quartile-stability flags.
No rotation speed, velocity field, fitted inclination, kinematic angle, target residual, halo fit, action, universal constant, evidence split or Solar-System optimization enters this checkpoint.
